summary: MCP list tools without provider paging must offer a local continuation cursor whenever output bounding would omit items.
reason: Splitwise groups, friends, categories, comments, and currencies can exceed the MCP output budget. A bounded first page without a cursor silently hides the rest of the list; local cursors must be consumed by MCP and never forwarded to Splitwise. The output regression test must retain trailing TSV delimiters because an empty last cell is significant.
validated_outcome: Offline mock-server test resumes after 50 items and verifies the cursor never appears in the upstream request. The full suite also preserves empty trailing TSV cells while parsing command output.
